# MetricCapsule

Surfaces one operational number in a header or toolbar.

`SuDuAI.MetricCapsule` · Data

## Use

```jsx
<SuDuAI.MetricCapsule />
```

```html
<x-import component-from-global-scope="SuDuAI.MetricCapsule"></x-import>
```

## Notes

Read-only metric capsule — latency, temperature, token counts.

## Props (MetricCapsuleProps)

| prop | type | note |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `icon` | `string` | Material Symbols glyph, 16px. |
| `label` | `React.ReactNode` | Muted descriptor, e.g. "Latency". |
| `value` | `React.ReactNode` | Emphasized value, e.g. "18ms". |
| `iconColor` | `string` | Glyph color. Default --tertiary-fixed-dim. |
